message.content: {"hts_code": "1904.10.0010", "reason": "Frozen shrimp spring rolls with a rice flour wrapper are a prepared food product not elsewhere specified, classified under heading 1904 (prepared foods obtained by swelling or roasting cereals), with 1904.10 covering ready-to-eat or prepared cereal products and the statistical suffix for frozen/unspecified prepared foods; however, since the product is primarily a shrimp-based filled preparation, it may instead fall under 1601 or 1605 depending on predominant character, and the cereal-based wrapper classification is the most applicable heading here."}

predicted_reason: Frozen shrimp spring rolls with a rice flour wrapper are a prepared food product not elsewhere specified, classified under heading 1904 (prepared foods obtained by swelling or roasting cereals), with 1904.10 covering ready-to-eat or prepared cereal products and the statistical suffix for frozen/unspecified prepared foods; however, since the product is primarily a shrimp-based filled preparation, it may instead fall under 1601 or 1605 depending on predominant character, and the cereal-based wrapper classification is the most applicable heading here.
